question: Should OpenClaw add task-level model metadata to `HEARTBEAT.md`, keep heartbeat routing as whole-turn plugin policy, or design a broader heartbeat routing hook/API first?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but implementation depends on maintainer intent for public `HEARTBEAT.md` syntax, split-versus-batched model calls, and how task-level overrides compose with provider auth, fallbacks, and session state.

options.title: Design shared routing contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable heartbeat/task routing contract before accepting `HEARTBEAT.md`-only syntax.

options.title: Add heartbeat-only task metadata
options.body: Implement a narrow `HEARTBEAT.md` task `model` field with explicit split/group semantics, docs, and compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep routing plugin-owned
options.body: Document whole-turn `before_model_resolve` plugins as the supported model-routing path and explicitly leave multiple due heartbeat tasks un-split for now.

recommendation.title: Design shared routing contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable heartbeat/task routing contract before accepting `HEARTBEAT.md`-only syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest related product-scope signal for deciding core versus plugin ownership of model-routing surfaces.
